mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL (inflation rate) at the decision date is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as elevated inflation pressures typically lead to tighter monetary policy and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 200 (as of the decision date).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% (as measured at the decision date) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it triggers expectations of monetary easing and fiscal stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which is associated with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month rolling averages.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime (defined by annualized industrial production growth above 2.0%), strong manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO annualized growth is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns, as a strengthening labor market supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising (as measured by the 3-month change).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a robust economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL annualized growth above 3.0%), elevated inflation pressures lead to aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized growth is above 3.0%.
